introHtml: Spec camping mugs are known for their durable speckled enamel finish and classic campfire aesthetic. These 16 oz mugs hold up to hot drinks and outdoor use, making them a favorite for corporate retreats, promotional giveaways, and employee appreciation gifts. The speckled coating hides wear and adds a nostalgic look that stands out from standard stainless steel or ceramic options. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or engraving for a lasting impression.
